structure_policy_rationale: The reference examples (Alipay, Bilibili) demonstrate that complex logos are preserved as exact 3D extrusions. For Tencent Video, the three overlapping triangles form a unique geometric signature that must remain intact to be recognizable. The transformation is purely material (flat vector -> 3D ice block) and chromatic (multi-color -> unified ice blue), without altering the silhouette or internal segmentation lines.
preserve: Internal division lines separating the three bands (rendered as grooves or internal refraction lines)
Rounded, fluid curvature of outer edges
must_preserve: Geometric integrity of the 'Play' button symbol
Relative proportions of the three bands
recompose_allowed: Replace original Blue/Green/Orange colors with unified Ice Blue/Translucent White palette
Convert flat surfaces to volumetric 3D extrusion with Z-axis thickness
Represent internal band details via embedded snowflakes, bubbles, or refraction lines instead of solid color fills
restyle: Apply translucent crystalline ice material with subsurface scattering
Add surface condensation droplets and glossy highlights
Embed micro-textures of snowflakes and air bubbles within the volume
decorate: Small melting water puddle effect at the bottom anchor point
forbid: Retaining original Green or Orange brand colors
Solid opaque plastic or metal material
Removing internal segmentation lines (must not become a solid single triangle)
Adding unrelated props (TV sets, film reels, characters)
generation_brief: 3D icon of Tencent Video logo as a translucent ice sculpture. Shape: Three nested triangular bands forming a play button, extruded with thickness. Material: Pale cyan ice crystal with subsurface scattering, internal bubbles, and snowflake textures. Surface: Glossy, wet with condensation droplets. Background: Pure white with subtle contact shadow and water puddle at base. High fidelity, refreshing atmosphere.
color_application: Discard original Blue/Green/Orange. Apply uniform 'Ice Blue' and 'Translucent White' palette. Use lightness variations and refraction to imply depth between layers, not color hue.
stroke_application: No 2D strokes. Define edges through 3D volume, beveled rounded corners, and specular highlights/refraction typical of polished ice.
composition_application: Centered composition. Object occupies 70-80% of canvas. Slight 3D perspective to show thickness. Grounded on white background with shadow/puddle.
identity_application: Preserve exact geometric silhouette of the three-layered triangle. Maintain the central negative space. Identity is conveyed through shape fidelity, not color.
fidelity_constraints: Must use unified ice blue semi-transparent material
Must exhibit 3D volume and subsurface scattering
negative_constraints: No distortion of the triangular play button geometry
